rapport_notes: Warm, personable tone with light humor ('football is definitely at your house this season'); customer is repeat client and rep leveraged that well.
process_discipline_notes: No silence held after the agenda question — rep immediately pivots to logistics probing without waiting for customer to fully articulate concerns.

evidence_quotes.agenda: Rep asks: 'Before I hop in, do you have any just top of mind important questions or concerns that I can address right now?' Customer says 'Nope, I did a move with you all back in 2021 and it was the easiest move I've done on my entire life.'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No follow-up on customer's statement. Customer volunteered a positive experience but rep did not probe deeper — no 'what made that easy for you?' or 'what do you want to make sure happens again this time?' Rep pivoted immediately to logistics: 'Okay, what that means is this move is gonna be even easier... Alright, so we are moving you from...'
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage: Rep addresses TV damage concern: 'Well just so you know, we do have our know where we damage coverage and if anything were to kind of go rive, which it won't but if it does, we do have that does cover-up to $2,000 worth of kind of incidentals or anything like that.'
evidence_quotes.no_estimate: No estimate range given. Rep collects details (bed breakdown, TV, boxes, parking access, distances) but never anchors with 'A typical one-bedroom takes X movers Y–Z hours' or personalizes ('Since you've got that 77-inch and the longer walk at destination, I'd expect you toward the higher end').
evidence_quotes.no_save_your_ass: No Save Your Ass lines delivered. No mention of rate-locking, payment terms, incremental billing, prep tips, or 'does that feel fair?' closing anchor.

top_strength: Excellent rapport and active listening — rep remembered the customer is a repeat client, validated that experience, engaged warmly with details (TV comment, bed setup), and proactively addressed the customer's unvoiced concern about TV damage coverage.
coaching_note: This call stops at logistics collection and never enters Stage 2 or Stage 3: no estimate anchor, no On-Time or Communication differentiators, no Save Your Ass framework, and no closing ask; rep needs to push past details-gathering into the value-frame and close structure to lock the booking.
